text:
Anna (docs): Quick heads-up — I opened a small PR to add a concrete example for quantized batching + tenant isolation in the Dedicated provisioning guide. Needs a content review. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/docs/pulls/4123 :wave:

Mike (eng): Thanks — linking it now. Which doc path did you touch?

Anna (docs): docs/dedicated/provisioning/tenant-playbook.md. The diff is focused on the 'autoscale policy' section and the YAML snippet for reserved pools.

Lina (platform): Quick skim — the YAML looks fine but we need to call out the isolation decorator so SREs don't accidentally put multi-tenant workloads in the reserved pool. Maybe add an explicit warning block.

Anna (docs): Good call. Suggested wording in the PR: "IMPORTANT: Reserved pools with isolation: soft must not be used for regulated workloads; use isolation: strict and pin model-version." Thoughts?

Jeff (ml): Also add a short SDK snippet showing how to request the quantized-llama-q4 model via the SDK when using dedicated endpoints. Many customers copy-paste to their onboarding scripts.

Anna (docs): Posted a tiny SDK example — two lines:
```python
from redwood import client
c = client.DedicatedClient(pool_id='tenant-foo')
c.generate(model='quantized-llama-q4', prompt='...')
```
Is that too hand-wavy?

Mike (eng): That's perfect as a quickstart. Maybe add one-line note about quantization tradeoffs (latency vs. token quality) and link to Optimize guide. I can drop the link.

Carla (pm): Can we include an example of autoscale cooldown and burst_policy so folks know how to avoid accidental warmup storms? A tiny YAML snippet would help.

Anna (docs): Added this YAML to the PR: 
```yaml
autoscale:
  min_instances: 1
  max_instances: 8
  cooldown_seconds: 300
  burst_policy: "conservative"
```
Also added a short note: "conservative burst_policy favors latency SLOs over aggressive scale-up to reduce cost spikes."

Lina (platform): One small nit — replace "conservative" with the canonical key name we use in code: "burst_strategy: conservative". We renamed it in the autoscaler API last quarter. Otherwise LGTM.

Anna (docs): Good catch — fixed in PR.

Docs Bot: PR 4123 updated: reviewer requested changes -> @Lina requested key name change.

Jeff (ml): For the isolation warning, suggest adding a tiny troubleshooting bullet: "If jobs are preempted, check tenant labels and reserved pool assignment; recommended label: tenant: regulated."

Anna (docs): Added troubleshooting bullet. I also fixed two broken links that pointed to old handbook slugs (they were 404ing).

Mike (eng): I'll run a quick link-checker on the PR before merge. If green, we can merge and cherry-pick into the on-prem fork.

Carla (pm): Timeline? This should go out before next week's customer onboarding wave.

Anna (docs): Aiming to merge today; will ping when CI green.

Docs Bot: Link-check: running...

Docs Bot: Link-check: completed — 0 broken links found.

Mike (eng): CI green from my side. Merging in 10.

Anna (docs): Merged. Thanks everyone! :tada:

Lina (platform): Can someone create a tiny follow-up issue to add the SDK example to the onboarding template in the onboarding repo? I can do it if no one has bandwidth.

Carla (pm): I'll add it to the onboarding checklist.

Anna (docs): Filed issue #789 in docs meta to track onboarding template update. Closing thread.
